notes: This contract records Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Delay Subscription Evaluation behavior in the non-installable embedded development profile. The source semantic block is §8.1.8; the pinned Requirements Lab export gives these immutable candidates a stale annex display title and the erroneous §8.1.10 clause metadata, as recorded by RL-018. Enabled federations retain a joined non-source recipient route for ordinary Send Interaction and ordinary Update Attribute Values only when planning finds no current subscription, then project the recipient's current active subscription at the HLA_EVOKED receive-order boundary or at the time-constrained TSO grant boundary. The attribute-update cases establish a known object before dropping and restoring its attribute declaration, so they isolate subscription timing from discovery. Disabled federations retain the existing generation-time ineligibility decision. Both modes re-evaluate a previously selected recipient immediately before an actual callback. This slice excludes Send Interaction With Regions, Update Attribute Values with explicit update-region associations, directed interactions, complete HLA_IMMEDIATE/asynchronous-delivery timing, late join/resignation races, retraction edge cases, distributed transport, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, and conformance.
